description: WRADER Q1 Plus Android TV Box – Powerful & Versatile Home Entertainment Bring more entertainment options to your compatible television with the WRADER Q1 Plus Android TV Box. Featuring 4GB RAM and 32GB internal storage, the Q1 Plus provides ample capacity for compatible applications and media. With support for up to 4K Ultra HD playback, you can enjoy compatible high-resolution content on a compatible 4K display. The HDMI port provides a convenient connection to your TV, while AV output offers additional compatibility with supported displays. For networking, the Q1 Plus comes with Dual Band WiFi and a LAN port, giving you both wireless and wired connectivity options. Bluetooth 5.0 allows connection with compatible wireless accessories. The box also features 2 USB ports, an SD card slot and IR support, making it a versatile choice for your home entertainment setup.
